objective: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

description: <name>, your service is of great value to us, so we are reluctant to send you on this last mission for we do not want to lose such a useful agent.
But its success would further our war efforts tremendously and... it was deemed worth risking you.
We want these captains in the Molten Core destroyed: Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah.  Kill them and bring me their hands!
This task will take every resource you possess, <name>, but if you can do it then the Firelords will be dealt a terrible blow.
progress: Have you defeated Lucifron and the others, <name>?  Do you have the hands of the enemy?
completion: You have the hands!  You defeated the fire captains!  I would not have thought it possible, had I not known you and what you are capable of.
<name>, your exploits are without number, but word of this last feat will send waves among the Waterlords.  Your name may one day be legend to us.
Speak with me again, <name>.  I may have yet another task...
